sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: When MusicBrainz refuses only searches because it is busy (an HTTP 503 marked "search-shed"), only searches now wait: this script's own lookups (the Relationships column, link previews, entity pictures) and those of majkinetor's scripts in every tab go on. Before, this script answered such a refusal by stopping every script's requests for a second or more. Its own searches (the millisecond lengths of a recording list, an event's release group lookup) now also wait when one of majkinetor's scripts saw such a refusal. As in majkinetor's request gate, every wait after a refusal gets up to half a second at random, so the waiting requests of many tabs do not all start again at the same moment, and a wait MusicBrainz names itself (Retry-After), or a refusal because all of MusicBrainz is out of room, is no longer stretched after repeated refusals. Only with "Share MusicBrainz's request budget with other userscripts (mbu:mb-gate)" on.
